items.title: Show HN: Google translate replacement for language learners
items.contentSnippet:
Hi HN, I'm Musab and I'm building Manalect. Find TL;DR at the end.
Most language apps fall short for me in two ways:
1. They’re not personalized enough. I get taught things I don’t care about, things that are too hard for me, and things I already know.
2. They don’t teach that well. I keep seeing question types where my brain does almost no work to figure out the answer, therefore learn nothing.

items.title: Show HN: I got tired of travel spreadsheets so I made a travel planner app
items.contentSnippet:
Hey everyone! I couldn't find an app to organize trips that gave me all the info I wanted to schedule each stop per day, with travel times, leeway, etc, so I made Wherewhen.
The basic differentiator is that you can set various constraints (e.g. "I want to spend 2 hours in the park", or "I have a dinner reservation at 6"), and Wherewhen will automatically adjust the rest of the times to tell you when to go/leave each place, including travel.
